images.title: A mat with 5 equal sides
images.purpose: Show the border of a mat as its sides, each marked 7 cm, so that the student can add the sides one by one to find the length of the lace.
images.composition: One five-sided mat in the middle with its five sides marked.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Centre, one mat with exactly 5 equal sides, drawn as a flat five-sided shape with its 5 corners at the points (728, 187), (930, 334), (853, 572), (603, 572), (526, 334) in order, starting at the top and going clockwise, so each side is 250 px long. The shape is filled amber #E69F00 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (4 px) and has no inner lines. Each of the 5 sides has its own label 7 cm, in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (36 px), centred just outside the middle of its side at the points (857, 222), (937, 468), (728, 620), (519, 468), (599, 222) in the same order. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 62, the heading A mat with 5 equal sides in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). In all there is 1 shape, 5 corners, 5 sides and 5 labels. No sum, no total and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a shape with a number of sides other than 5, sides of unequal length, or any side label other than 7 cm
a perimeter, a sum or an answer written anywhere in the frame
images.takeaway: The border of the mat is made of 5 sides, each 7 cm, and the perimeter is the length of all of them together.
images.description: A mat with 5 equal sides, each marked 7 cm.
images.context: Concept image for Perimeter: The Border of a Shape. It uses the numbers of this concept's own example, 5 equal sides of 7 cm, and gives no total.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student walk round the border with a finger, saying each side. The slip to watch: adding only some of the sides, or counting the corners instead of the sides.

image_decisions.why: The mat with its five marked sides makes 'add the length of every side' something the student can do on the picture.
